body.name: \(h_{n,k}(O)\)
body.space: the direct sum \(\mathbb R\oplus L_2^0(P_n(\,\cdot\mid R=1))\oplus L_2^0(P_n(\,\cdot\mid R=0))\)
body.def: \(h_{n,k}=(\beta_{n,k},\psi_{n,k}-E_{P_n}[\psi_{n,k}\mid R=1],\psi_{n,k}-E_{P_n}[\psi_{n,k}\mid R=0])\), with the two function coordinates restricted to their respective strata and weighted by \(\lambda_{n,\mathcal R}\) and \(\lambda_{n,\mathcal E}\).
